name: CMHC Rental Market Survey: average rents (Statistics Canada table 34-10-0133-01)
publisher: Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation, republished by Statistics Canada

measures.definition: Sitting rent: the average monthly rent of every occupied one-bedroom unit in purpose-built rental apartments and rows of three units or more, old and new tenancies, surveyed each October, for the census metropolitan area. Rent only, utilities as each lease includes them.

Sitting rent: the average monthly rent of every occupied three-bedroom unit in purpose-built rental apartments and rows of three units or more, surveyed each October, for the census metropolitan area.

vetted.notes: Read first-hand 2026-11-05: the StatCan Open Licence does not cover this table, whose note points to CMHC's licence (revocable, recipients bound).

caveats: Purpose-built rentals only: condominiums and houses rented out privately, a large share of the market in Toronto and Vancouver, are not in it, and a new tenancy usually costs more than the average.
Statistics Canada's table says the CMHC figures are provided subject to CMHC's licence, so they are published in their own file (public/data/dataset-cmhc.json).
